_comment: cloud-ci-canonical-json determinism gate policy (DATA, not code). ADR-0546, converts FRIC-1781130000: a lane silently re-encoded specs/root-hub-pointers.json from escaped-unicode to literal UTF-8, producing ~30 lines of churn (a hermetic-output failure: same logical content, non-deterministic bytes). Every tracked *.json under governed_roots must equal its canonical re-serialization. ALL repo-specifics live here; the Rust kernel hardcodes no oyatie path and runs on any repo by repointing governed_roots + canonical_form. Canonical bytes are produced by a self-contained lexical canonicalizer (NOT serde_json::to_string_pretty), so the gate's output is independent of the serde_json preserve_order/arbitrary_precision feature union reindeer applies workspace-wide.

canonical_form._comment: The settled one-way-door dialect (ADR-0546). ALL six fields are live DATA read by CanonicalForm::from_policy and honored by the formatter (an adopting repo may set newline=crlf or utf8_bom=true). ensure_ascii=false (literal UTF-8) matches the faces serializer accounting-registry::to_canonical_json (18310 literal-non-ASCII lines, 0 escaped) and RFC 8785 JCS minimal-escaping; sort_keys=false because the defect is rewrite nondeterminism, not key-order ambiguity, and sorting would churn 1452 repo files and destroy intentional order on the agent entry surface (gofmt/prettier preserve semantic order). indent_width=2 + trailing_newline=true + newline=lf + utf8_bom=false match the faces serializer and gofmt/prettier conventions.

exclusions._comment: suffixes: *.generated.json faces are owned byte-verbatim by the freshness/registry-drift gates (single-owner; no double-gating). path_prefixes: specs/fixtures/* are INPUTS owned byte-/parse-verbatim by 5 other gate test suites (firewall, cross-artifact-agreement, staleness-reaper, total-accounting, automation-ratchet); reformatting them is a cross-gate-ownership violation. Expansion to docs/, oya/, cloud/ dashboards is a follow-up IP per governed root (fixer run + this DATA edit), shrink-only.

product_contract.born_pack_shaped: The governed roots, the canonical-form parameters, and the exclusions are DATA here; the Rust kernel hardcodes no repo path nor any oyatie string, so another repo adopts this gate by editing this policy. The kernel fixes only the canonical-form ALGORITHM (lexer -> CST -> formatter), not any path.
product_contract.check_equals_fix: A file is canonical iff its committed bytes equal canonicalize(bytes). The gate (check) and the one-command fixer (write) share one definition (cargo fmt --check precedent), so the fixer can never disagree with the gate.
product_contract.ratchet: Born-blocking: after this PR's in-PR fix of the 7 non-canonical spec files, the live corpus is green at ZERO baseline, so any NEW non-canonical governed JSON fails closed. Appending a CANONICAL json file never fails the gate.
product_contract.fixer_refuses_defects: The fixer rewrites only formatting/encoding drift. It REFUSES (never silently rewrites) a file that fails to parse or carries duplicate keys — those are human-judgment defects, not drift.
product_contract.execution: Buck2-native Rust gate; no Cargo command is required for enforcement.

purpose: Canonical-JSON determinism gate. Every tracked *.json under governed roots must equal its canonical re-serialization (stable key order, fixed indent, explicit ensure_ascii policy); the gate normalizes-and-compares and fails on byte drift, with a one-command fixer. Deterministic serialization is part of hermetic output for any repo.
